contemplative_note: The wall that once symbolized ruin becomes a platform for shared gratitude; survival is turned into song.
safety_note: Genealogical and priestly status in this ancient setting must not be converted into modern hereditary spiritual superiority. Purification language is ritual and must not stigmatize people as inherently unclean.
